p.d: Баба Нина – уникальная ведунья, которая уединённо живёт в глуши, но к которой обращаются десятки людей. Эта слепая женщина обладает уникальным даром провидения и может рассказать многое о человеке и его судьбе.

Абсолютно новый проект на ТВ-3! Он живет уединенно в лесу, вдали от городской суеты и волнений. Но его деревянный дом, полный света и тепла, становится маяком для всякого, кто потерял надежду и заблудился в лабиринте жизни. Ведь он тот, кто видит судьбу...

Программа Порча, которую можете смотреть онлайн - это докудрама о реальных жизненных ситуациях. Иногда в окружении появляется тот, кто желает зла настолько, что не остановится ни перед чем. Зависть, ненависть и другие негативные чувства толкают людей к контакту со сверхъестественным. И в нашей жизни наступает черная полоса. Мы задаемся вопросом: почему все валится из рук, преследуют несчастья, болезни и невезение в любви и браке? Ответ на этот вопрос может быть простым, но зловещим: на вас навели порчу. Смотрите онлайн докудраму Порча на телеканале Домашний, в которой герои обращаются к Тамаре - женщине, обладающей сверхъестественными способностями. Она может увидеть, есть ли на человеке отметка тьмы, и помочь отвести беду. В каждом выпуске программы будет воссоздан реальный случай из практики Тамары - когда отчаявшиеся люди обращались к ней за помощью. Тамара расскажет, как узнать, что на вас навели порчу, и что делать, если это действительно произошло. На официальном сайте телеканала Домашний вы можете смотреть онлайн все серии докудрамы Порча в хорошем качестве.

Komēdijā "Nacionālā drošība" populārais komiķis Martins Laurenss atveido policijas kadetu, kurš dienās varētu kļūt par pirmšķirīgu policistu, taču viņš ir pārāk centīgs. Tādēļ no policijas skolas viņš tiek izmests. Ar naidu pret visiem, kuriem pieder policista žetons, Erls dodas, kurp deguns rāda... Atklājis, ka mašīnas durvis aizcirtušās, bet atslēga palikusi aizdedzē, Erls, pūlēdamies atmūķēt auto, iepazīstas ar policistu, kuram viņš liekas aizdomīgs. Policists Erla dēļ zaudē darbu un tiek notiesāts. Tomēr liktenis lemj, ka abi atkal satiekas vienā darbā – apsardzē. Pārinieki viens par otru galīgi nav sajūsmā, lai neteiktu vairāk... Kā abi sastrādāsies, maigi sakot, naidīgā gaisotnē?

Primatologs Deiviss labprātāk uzturas dzīvnieku, nevis cilvēku sabiedrībā, un ciešākā draudzība viņu saista ar gorillu, par kuru viņš rūpējies kopš mazotnes. Taču nelikumīgu ģenētisko eksperimentu rezultātā mierīgais pērtiķis tiek pārvērsts par milzīga auguma agresīvu mutantu, turklāt izrādās, ka viņš nav vienīgais modificētais dzīvnieks. Kamēr jaunradītie plēsēji siro pa Ziemeļameriku, iznīcinot savā ceļā pilnīgi visu, Deiviss cenšas novērst globālo katastrofu un glābt mežonīgo zvēru, kas reiz bija viņa draugs. Asa sižeta zinātniskās fantastikas trilleris tapis pēc pagājušā gadsimta astoņdesmito gadu videospēles motīviem.

Kaķis, vārdā Deķīts, laiski vada dienas lielpilsētas daudzstāvu nama dzīvoklī kopā ar savu dēlēnu Klaiņu. Kādudien zinātkārais kaķēns Klaiņa pamet mājas un dodas dēkainā ceļojumā uz teiksmaino kaķu paradīzi. Zinot, ka plašajā pasaulē briesmas draud uz katra stūra, Deķīts, spītējot bailēm, steidzas glābt savu dēlu.

Ītans Hants un viņa komanda uzsāk savu līdz šim visbīstamāko misiju – atrast un iznīcināt šausminošu jaunu ieroci, kas apdraud visu cilvēci, pirms tas nonācis nepareizajās rokās. Kad uz spēles ir likta visas pasaules nākotne, un Ītana pagātnes tumšie spēki tuvojas, sākas skrējiens uz dzīvību un nāvi apkārt pasaulei.
Stāsts par karaļa Luija XV pēdējo oficiālo mīļāko Dibarī kundzi.

Princis Fabiuss allaž drosmīgi metas kaujās, izcīna vienu uzvaru pēc otras, iekarojot karaļvalsts iedzīvotāju sirdis. Viņa brālis, slinkais princis Tadeuss, tā vietā izvēlējies laisku dzīvesveidu – burvju zālīti, dziru un izklaides. Taču, kad ļaunais burvis nolaupa Fabiusa līgavu Belladonnu, karalis uzstāda dēlam ultimātu – vai nu saņemties drosmi un piedalīties princeses glābšanas misijā, vai arī palikt bez mantojuma. Brāļus gaida tāls ceļš cauri mežonīgām zemēm, cīņas ar šausminošiem nezvēriem, sadursmes ar nodevīgiem bruņiniekiem, kā arī iepazīšanās ar brīnumdaiļo Izabellu, kurai ar ļauno burvi kārtojami pašai savi rēķini.

"Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

Kad pētnieks Dērks Pits atrod noslēpumainu monētu, kas saistīta ar vēsturisku leģendu, sākas viņa mūža aizraujošākie piedzīvojumi - bagātību meklējumos viņš ceļo cauri bīstamākajiem Āfrikas rietumu apgabaliem. Meklējot kuģi, ko vietējie dēvē par "Nāves kuģi" - sen pazudušu Pilsoņu kara kaujas kuģi, kurā glabājas slepena krava - Dērks un viņa asprātīgais ceļabiedrs Als Džordžino sastop daiļu sievieti un spožu zinātnieci Evu Rohas, kas uzskata, ka bruņukuģis ir saistīts ar daudzu cilvēku bojāeju šajā reģionā. Meklējot kuģi, ko daudzi uzskata par neesošu, Dērks, Als un Eva var paļauties tikai uz savu prātu un drošsirdību, lai pārspētu bīstamos militāristus un izdzīvotu mežonīgajos Sahāras apstākļos, atklājot senos noslēpumus.

Deniss Kveids ģimenes filmā par draudzību vairāku mūžu garumā. Suns Beilijs laimīgi dzīvo kādā fermā Mičiganā kopā ar savu saimnieku Ītanu un viņa sievu Hannnu. Viņam ir arī rotaļu biedrene - Ītana un Hannas mazmeitiņa Sīdžeja. Diemžēl kādudien Sīdžejas mamma nolemj aizvest meitenīti prom. Kad Beilija dvēsele gatavojas pamest šo dzīvi, lai sāktu jaunu, viņš apsola Ītanam, ka atradīs Sīdžeju un sargās viņu, lai ko tas prasītu. Tā sākas Beilija ceļojums cauri daudzām dzīvēm, kas piepildītas ar mīlestību, draudzību un uzticību.

Nogurusi no terora mājās, kāda nežēlīga vīra nomocīta sieva maina identitāti un kopā ar savu piecgadīgo meitiņu bēg no ļaundara. Saniknotais vīrs nedomā padoties un bēgles vienmēr atrod. Līdz brīdim, kad sieva saprot, ka vienīgais veids, lai uzvarētu naida apmāto un pārstātu bēguļot, ir stāties viņam pretī. Sievietē notiek neticamas pārmaiņas - no upura viņa kļūst par stipru sievieti, kura stājas pretī savam pāri darītājam. Galvenajās lomās Dženifera Lopesa un Billijs Kempbels.

Dika Hārpera ilgā un pacietīgā kāpšana pa karjeras kāpnēm beidzot ir vainagojusies ar panākumiem - viņš tiek iecelts par viceprezidentu kompānijā, kas ir pasaules mēdiju tirgus līdere. Taču tā ir tikai viena triumfa pilna diena - firma izput un Diks paliek pie sasistas siles bez jebkādiem iekrājumiem. Tagad viņam kopā ar sievu Džeinu jānoskatās, kā viņu greznā māja, automašīnas un labākie draugi izgaist viens pēc otra. Bet pat strādājot vienkāršu darbu, Diks nav gatavs nodot savu amerikāņu sapni un, ņemot piemēru no sava korumpētā bosa, nonāk pie lieliskas idejas - ja jau zagt var viņa boss, tad arī Dikam tas nesīs savu labumu. Liekot lietā jaunos talantus, viņam un Džeinai izdodas lielas lietas.

Piedzīvojumu filmu zvaigznes - Silvestrs Stallone, Džeisons Stethems, Brūss Viliss, Arnolds Švarcenegers, Žans Klods van Damme, Džets Li, Dolfs Lundgrēns un Čaks Noriss atgriežas kases grāvēja "Neiznīcināmie" turpinājumā! Šoreiz viss ir ļoti personiski. Bārnijs Ross un viņa bijušo algotņu banda sanāk kopā, kad Čērča kungs neiznīcināmajiem uzdod šķietami vieglu darbu. Bārnijam liekas, ka gaidāma viegla peļņa. Kad viss saiet grīstē un kāds no neiznīcināmajiem tiek nežēlīgi nogalināts, viņiem jāatriebjas ienaidnieka teritorijā, un tur izredžu ir ļoti maz.

Rakstnieks Riks Rodžers uzrakstījis grāmatu "Asiņojošais tērauds", kas stāsta par meiteni ar mehānisko sirdi. Pārģērbies par prostitūtu pie rakstnieka ierodas Li Sens, kurš sazāļo viņu un nozog grāmatu. Pēkšņi numuriņā ielaužas bruņoti vīri, kuri vēlas zināt - kur viņš smēlies iedvesmu savai grāmatai. Cīņā iesaistās arī Honkongas īpašais aģents Lins Dongs, kuru interesē tieši tāds pats jautājums. Kāpēc šis stāsts ir tik svarīgs?

Visapkārt sākas nemieri, taču Beatrisei Priorai ir jāturpina centieni glābt savus mīļos, vienlaikus cīnoties ar sēru un piedošanas dilemmu. Beatrises iesvētību dienai būtu jākļūst par uzvaras svinībām kopā ar viņas grupu, taču diena beidzas ar neiedomājamām šausmām. Tagad dažādo grupu konflikts un ideoloģiju atšķirības draud izvērsties karā, tāpēc katram jāizvēlas, kā pusē cīnīties. Pašas lēmumu ietekmētā Beatrise pilnībā pieņem savu citādību, lai gan viņa nezina, ko var zaudēt šādas rīcības rezultātā.

"Pasaki to skaļi" 5. sezonā vadītāja krēslu līdzās Elīnai Fīrmanei uz laiku ieņems TV personība Roberto Meloni. Roberto ir ļoti iepriecināts un gandarīts, ka var vadīt, viņaprāt, sirsnīgāko un emocionālāko TV raidījumu ar tik lielu virsvērtību kā pateicība! Arī šajā sezonā satiksim interesantus cilvēkus, lai uzklausītu viņu stāstus un paldies vārdus kādiem īpašiem cilvēkiem, dzīves skolotājiem vai vecākiem un, cerams, tie iedvesmo arī mūsu skatītājus teikt vairāk pateicības vārdus skaļi.

Panda vārdā Po, pazīstams arī kā Pūķa Cīnītājs, ir slavens ar īpašajām cīņas mākslas prasmēm, ar ko viņš uzveicis pasaules līmeņa ļaundarus. Po piedzīvojumi turpinās - viņš trenējas, aizsargā, cīnās, māca, apmāca, reizēm klūp, bieži vien pārāk daudz runā un arī izklaidējas. Po tagad dzīvo Miera ielejā, kazarmās kopā ar saviem uzticamajiem draugiem - Nikno piecinieku, un piedzīvojumu viņiem netrūkst!

Dokumentālais kultūras un ceļojumu šovs atgriežas ar aizraujošu devīto sezonu, aicinot skatītājus doties pasaules neparastākajos dzelzceļa maršrutos. No vēsturiskiem tvaika dzinējiem līdz moderniem ātrvilcieniem - katrs brauciens atklāj satriecošas dabas ainavas un unikālas vietējās kopienas. Šajā sezonā kopā ar harizmātisko vadītāju skatītāji nonāks tādās kontrastējošās vietās kā eksotiskā Kambodža, skarbā un skaistā Zviedrijas ziemeļu daba, kā arī krāšņā Vidusjūras pērle Sicīlija. Kāp uz borta un piedzīvo pasauli no cita skatu punkta -kur pats ceļojums ir galamērķis!

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē "Viens pret visiem" spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi - slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam - pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Losandželosas slepkavību izmeklētājs leitnants Kolumbo varbūt ir necils pēc izskata un uzvedības - vienkārši ģērbies, kluss un pieklājīgs, skumji smēķē savu cigāru. Tomēr šī neievērojamā āriene slēpj, iespējams, neatlaidīgāko un drosmīgāko izmeklētāju pilsētā. Tieši Kolumbo tiek iedalītas skaļākās un sarežģītākās lietas, kurās iesaistīts Losandželosas pilsētas zieds - slavenie, bagātie un ietekmīgie. Ieraugot Kolumbo, vainīgie bieži jūtas uzjautrināti un drošībā - šis vīrs nebūs spējīgs viņus izskaitļot. Kolumbo pierādīs pretējo!

Zagļu grupējums, kas sevi dēvē par "Santaklausa bandu", rada haosu Marseļā, un policija nespēj tikt galā. Policijas šefa Žilbēra uzmanību novērš kāda ķīniešu reportiere, kas veido rakstu par policijas vienību, izmeklētāja Emiljēna sieva nupat ir paziņojusi, ka ir stāvoklī, un taksometra šofera Daniela attiecībās ir krīze. Policiju vairākkārt gudrībā apsteidz zagļi, un reportiere to visu fiksē, tāpēc pie darba ir jāķeras Danielam un viņa supertaksometram.

Džeina Mārpla, pazīstama kā mis Mārpla, ir dāma, kas dzīvo Sentmērimīdā un palīdz draugiem un paziņām atšķetināt visdažādākos noziegumus - izveicīgāko noziedznieku pastrādātas slepkavības visnegaidītākajās vietās ar visneparastākajiem motīviem. Taču neviens no viņiem nevar mēroties gudrībā un atjautībā ar mis Mārplu. Galvenajās lomās: Džeraldīna Makīvena, Saimons Kelovs, Džeks Devenports

Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.
Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.
Jennifer fears for Jonathan's life when ruthless jewel thieves take him hostage during a robbery while he's on a business trip in Paris.

Drama starring Edward Asner (ʻLou Grantʼ). A soldier serving in Afghanistan is touched by an anonymous Christmas card sent by a woman in California. Upon completion of his tour of duty, he returns to the United States on a romantic mission to find the woman who wrote the card.

Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

In the series premiere of THE LAST ALASKANS, three families living in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge prepare for the upcoming winter due to arrive in just four weeks. It is September in Alaska, and Heimo and Edna Korth set out to hunt down the tail end of a caribou migration. Bob Harte arrives at his cabin to find it was ransacked by a young grizzly bear, destroying two years of his food supply, which ultimately forces Bob to fly his small single propeller plane to a tiny village located hundreds of miles away to resupply. The Lewis family of five arrives at the refuge with hope as signs of life have returned to the land surrounding their home after a wildfire forced most of the native animals to flee three years earlier. Once settled, Ray and his teenage daughters compete with hungry wolves to take down a moose in order to feed their family throughout the harsh winter. Later, both Heimo and Bob confront the personal tragedies that come with living in extreme isolation nearly 400 miles from civilization.

The story follows the work of the dedicated staff of Gulf Coast veterinary clinic, an emergency animal hospital where patients that require critical care are treated by professionals trained to handle a variety of services, ranging from routine check-ups to extremely complex veterinary procedures.

This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Informative magazine, that reports on different African themes using original and top journalism. It covers current affairs, politics and social issues in a unique way, presenting stories about inspirational individuals, events and various phenomena. Discover this continent in a completely new light, through these contemporary, untold and overlooked tales, brought to you by BBC's talented investigation team.

The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

Inside Politics is a political talk show, broadcast on CNN and anchored by CNN Chief National Correspondent John King. It features the most important political stories presented by a panel of well-sourced reporters. John King is an experienced reporter who covers the White House, Congress and the campaign trail, and interviews presidents, politicians and voters.

One of the CNN's longest running programmes that allows viewers to find out all the global sports news, see all the important events and most interesting parts, and enjoy the interviews with sports pundits and various sports stars.

Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.
My Drive. African Voices offers viewers a unique viewpoint, showcasing engaging African personalities in intimate discussions from business to music.

The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. Hosted by Eleni Giokos, the episodes bring stories about the fast growing industry, network communication, cross-border trade and increasing trading routes, air connectivity, logistics infrastructure, small businesses and more.

CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

A wet start to a new logging season has the Pelletiers up against the ropes. Lester and Wayne take on the steepest hill on the golden road while Eldon's plan to haul double loads of wood to the mills gets shut down.

Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

Others talked abount projects that are currently under construction like Tuneling Under the Alps. And some episodes talked about more futuristic projects that may never be done like the Transatlantic Tunnel. Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

As the days get shorter and colder, and snow is visible on the highest peaks, the builders frantically race to get their homes sealed in. Chuck Gerwig suffered a huge blow earlier in the summer with the loss of his righthand man, and now his ten hour days are up to twelve and its starting to show. Barely keeping in front of his subcontractors, one small mistake could mean not finishing. In Chicken, Jim Wagner's organizational luck has just run out. His flooring is four bundles short. So, with everything shutting down for the winter in a week, he's got to decide whether or not to make the half day journey to the lumberyard, which is no guarantee, or finish the roof before snow flies. Finally, at remote Quiet Lake, Lee Raymond's son "high speed, no grease" Aaron, is scrambling to get the roofing on before the snow. But the constant rain mixed with Aaron's speed has created a very slick situation and Aaron just can't hold on.

Winter has arrived and the race is over. It's time for each of our builders to come to terms with their end games as they pack up and head home for the season. To say this year has been a challenge would be an understatement. From lakes, to glaciers, to areas savaged by fire, nothing was immune from Alaska's hostile nature. Whether that came in the form of brutal weather, extreme fatigue, or even death, it had to be endured and overcome. And although the men, their homes and the sites were vastly different, they all can lay claim to the same victory in surviving Alaska's wrath. Now is the time to shutter in, rest, and take stock in what matters for in just a few short months the season will change again and usher in a new chapter of Building Alaska

Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm
p.d: In 2024, as a monster storm system unleashes a record-breaking derecho across Texas, eyewitnesses capture multiple destructive tornadoes on camera; when one twister targets a remote farmhouse, a weather spotter must race to save a young family.
After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO.

Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

Wildebeest and Zebra - Africa's most famous drifters. Hundreds of thousands of zebra live together in the Serengeti. Their distinctive eye-catching stripes are as unique as fingerprints and even within the largest of gatherings no two zebra will be found with exactly the same stripes. Turtles that make epic journeys to reproduce. The most abundant sea turtle in the world, Olive Ridleys' have extraordinary nesting habits. These small turtles migrate massive distances between their oceanic feeding grounds and the shores that draw them back to mate, and then to nest. Sooty Tern - Sea birds that don't come to land for years. Like the turtle, once it has left land for the first time, a young Sooty Tern may not go back for years, spending all its time in the ocean skies until it is time for it to breed. Soaring on outstretched wings, these elegant seabirds feed almost entirely on the fish driven to the surface by the hunters below. Australian Pelicans - Water birds that follow ephemeral rivers. Pelicans – these quirky, comical, big billed birds are usually thought of as spending all their time around coasts and harbors. They are widespread in Australia's lakes, rivers, billabongs and estuaries – or other waterway with enough food for their fish-loving lifestyle. The whales and whale sharks that roam the great oceans. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

The targeting Archer fish. Just below the surface of the water is one of nature's most precise miniature hunters – the fabulous Archer fish. Able to shoot down their prey with targeted jet propelled water darts the archer fish is bulls-eye accurate. The ambushing Portia. A mere centimeter in length, the Portia spider is one of nature's most capable and intelligent hunters. A formidable serial killer of other spiders, Portia's are fast to learn and quick to adapt. The harpooning cone shell. In an ocean full of fast moving and agile fish, those that hunt them need sure fire methods of capture. So it is perhaps surprising that one of their most deadly adversaries, is a very slow moving snail. Weapon swinging Bolas Spiders. As the day comes to and darkness sets in, one of the world's most deceptive hunters begins her nightly rituals. Dangling from the silken trapeze line she has just laid the female Bolas Spider spins a short silken thread punctuated with tiny globules and ending in one huge sticky silken bolas. Slave Making Ants. Running over almost every corner of the earth are millions and millions of tiny worker ants. Yet for some ant species, most of the workers are not their own blood. These are the slave makers trap laying Ant Lions. Throughout the sandy soils that blanket the earth there are hundreds of species of ants making a living on the land they find themselves. Yet there is one insect whose larvae makes a living on them – the one and a half centimeter, cunning, powerful, ferocious and often inconspicuous Ant lion Parasitic Pompilid wasps In the dunes of the Namib Desert is a little wasp that seeks out a very certain type of prey. Pompilid wasps, also known as spider wasps are named after the food they seek, and they are extremely good at seeking it.…which is the top of the micro predators?

Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Deserts are dry. Deserts are extreme. True deserts get less than 18 cm of rain per year. True deserts have very few plants. Semi-desert habitats have enough rainfall to support more plant and animal life. Either way, deserts are not easy places for animals to live. Desert animals have evolved to handle the desert's heat and lack of water. They have adapted their bodies and behaviors to the desert climate. Most can survive on small amounts of water and many get all of their water from their food. Some drink maybe once a week and travel considerable distances to find isolated waterholes and springs. Large animals seek shade during the hottest part of the day. Some animals dig a hollow depression into the ground and lie in the cooler soil while others are nocturnal. Many reptiles and other animals protect themselves from the extreme temperature by spending their time in burrows. The scorpion is one of the most ancient creatures on earth, in existence since life first crawled out of the sea. One look and you can see why they're born survivors. Not only are their bodies armoured against the desert heat - and other predators - but all scorpions have pincers at the front and a poisonous sting at the end of their tail. Rattlesnakes can be two meters long. They're fast, tough and with a deadly venom, making them one of the most dangerous snakes in the world. But nobody seems to have told the Roadrunner, who regard rattlesnakes as quite suitable prey.

These are Nature's own Battletanks, and (with the exception of the Indian Elephant), all endemic to the African continent. The African Savannah is the stage for thousands of battles every day. How do elephants, these large, cumbersome creatures survive and even prosper on a diet that even the strictest vegetarian would pass on! Well for one thing, most other animals get out of their way. But lions and hyenas are not always so easily moved – they prey on young, sick and old elephants in particular. This seemingly gentle giant has been revealed to have a darker side in the last few years too. They may survive on just plant life, but that doesn't mean they don't like a fight – to the death. Elephants have been observed attacking and killing Rhinos in the last 20 years. It's a savage clash. Meanwhile, the Rhino, a tough looking customer if ever there was one, is an endangered species. When the great herds go on the search for food, predators go on the hunt for them. If ever there was an animal that seems destined to survive, it's the Rhino, which has been around for over 6 million years. But it too has an enemy: mankind – the deadliest foe of all. Then there's the hippopotamus. An adult hippo is a huge, aggressive animal, and even the largest crocodiles tend to stay away from it. However, when baby hippos stray from their mothers, then crocodiles, lions and hyenas will have a go if they can get away without being attacked themselves by adults in the baby hippo's herd. That's why baby hippos must stay close to Mum

How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity…

February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where, in the past few years, diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan joins world-renown cave explorer Brian Kakuk to investigate the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world! The formations in this cave are simply stunning, and incredibly unique.

Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. But to find out, Jonathan has to brave some very cold water. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

Mankind has been flying for over a century. As early as the 1500s Leonardo da Vinci tried to build a flying machine. Drawing inspiration from birds he gave it wings. Unfortunately, his "Ornithopter" didn't work, and indeed, the airplanes of today do not have flapping wings! We also tried it with balloons. Huge 245-metre long airships that needed the guts of between 80,000 to 200,000 cows! But, it was the kite that became the forerunner of the flying machine. A kite made by the now famous Wright brothers. The two brothers were bicycle repairmen, which convinced them that a flying machine could be highly unstable and yet controllable, such as with bicycles. They built their kites as strong as their bicycle frames and used bicycle parts to test their workings. The early Wright planes could manage no more than 65 km/h. Nowadays, a commercial plane can top 800 km/h. What is it that make our current planes fly 12 times faster? Well, one British Royal Air pilot, Frank Whittle, remembered his school experiments with the 'Aeolipile', a piece of ancient Greek engineering. This pilot argued that we could fly faster - if we'd fly higher - because there is less air resistance at high altitudes. The future of aviation has lead to Airbus's A380, the largest passenger plane in the world as well as the scramjet built by NASA. So what will be the next quirky discovery for flight?

Cooling is more than a luxury. Nowadays it is a necessity. Without refrigerated shipping and stocking, fresh food wouldn't reach our supermarket so easily. Can you imagine living without it? Before the invention of the refrigerator, icehouses were used to provide cool storage for most of the year. To cool our food and beverages, blocks of ice were simply cut out of frozen lakes and shipped to far and beyond. The so-called "ice-industry" came to its end when, in the late 1900s, our waters became too polluted to serve as a cool preserving agent. Air-conditioning, on the other hand, was actually invented to control the humidity that was ruining the paper of printing offices, rather than the technology being used to cool you off. The quirky part is, you can't create cold; you can only "move" temperature form one place to another. The first one to find a technology that cooled the inside of a box - the forefather of the refrigerator - was a medical doctor. In fact, he thought he was building a machine to cure malaria. And yet it took over a century after that, before people started using refrigerators, because refrigerators were thought to be dangerous. And they had a point! For a few decades, the refrigerator was something of a killer machine (literally) as they omitted toxic gases that poisoned people… Even Einstein got worried and developed a cooling-machine. And when refrigerators stopped killing people, scientists discovered that refrigerants were harming the environment. All sorts of chemicals have passed through our refrigerator coils, to be discarded… but perhaps we have a new solution: cooling with the vibrations of sound. That does sound cool.
Gamačes jubilejas svinības Manoir Belleforet viesnīcā tiek pārtrauktas - atrasts ķermenis. Gamače ar komandu izmeklē lietu, kurā fokusējas uz viesnīcas īpašniekiem - disfunkcionālo Morovu ģimeni.
NBA zvaigznes Denisa Rodmena superzvaigznes statuss, ko viņš ieguva ar sava lielā talanta un trakoto ballīšu palīdzību, padarīja viņu neaizsargātu pret nodevībām un zādzībām no tuvāko cilvēku puses.

Kad plašsaziņas līdzekļos noplūda bēdīgi slavenaais seksa ieraksts, tas uz visiem laikiem mainīja viņa dzīvi. Atklāsim skandālus ārpus ringa, nemitīgās ķildas un cīņu par privātumu.
Bijušais NFL aizsargs Ērika Naposki mīlast trijstūra laikā iesaistījies slepkavības lietā, radot jautājumus par viņa vainu un galvas traumas iespējamo ietekmi.
Maiks Viljamss noslēpumaini pazūd savā kāzu gadadienā. Izskatās, ka viņu, iespējams, apēduši aligatori. Taču izskats var maldināt - lietas izmeklēšanā atklājas noslēpumi.
Kolorādo futbola mamma Peidža Birgfelda pazūd, un mazpilsēta ir satraukta. Policisti meklē pavedienus un šokējoši atklāj, ka šī uzticīgā māte dzīvo slepenu dubultdzīvi.

Šerija Leitija pazudusi Altonā, aiz sevis atstājot trīs mazos. Pēc 13 gadus ilgušas meklēšanas viņas māsa atklāj, ka baumas, ka Leitija pilsētu pametusi ar jaunu puisi, ir meli. Viņai tuvi cilvēki ilgstoši slēpuši tumšus noslēpumus.

Ciema iedzīvotāji saskaras ar savas pagātnes patiesību un medī savus kolektīvos dēmonu. Gamače saprot, ka Marka slepkavam bija ļoti personisks motīvs.
Gamačes jubilejas svinības Manoir Belleforet viesnīcā tiek pārtrauktas - atrasts ķermenis. Gamače ar komandu izmeklē lietu, kurā fokusējas uz viesnīcas īpašniekiem - disfunkcionālo Morovu ģimeni.
Nakts programma ar mūzikas video dažādām gaumēm. Dejojiet, dziediet līdzi vai izbaudiet, guļot zem segas.

Pegija nolemj aizsākgt jaunu hobiju un uzzīmēt Alu. To darot, viņa izveido savu žurnāla karikatūru, kurā Als padara viņu slavenu. Viņa radījusi nelaimīgo apavu pārdevēju "Mr. Empty Pants". Als vēlētos, lai slava būtu īslaicīga, līdz kāds cits žurnāls (Playgirl) pasludina viņu par seksa simbolu.

Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki. Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties – nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes –, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks – no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

Pēc Medisones un Džūlsas strīda, visas draudzenes nonāk Meksikā uz kāzu nogali, kas ātri vien noiet greizi: tiek atklāti noslēpumi, lietoti halucinogēni, un tiek pārbaudīta Džūlsas uzticība draudzenēm.

Džūlsa un draudzenes ir pavadījušas gadu mājas karantīnā, un beidzot pienācis laiks atgriezties pasaulē. Apmeklējot "TOP 30 līdz 30" ballīti, viņas pārdomā tuvojošās dzimšanas dienas, karjeras izmaiņas un nepiepildītos dzīves mērķus.
Džūlsa cenšas slēpt savu neparasti veiksmīgo dienu, jo Medisoni piemeklē viena nelaime pēc otras. Izija nezina vai afišēt savas jaunās attiecības. Stellai ir ideja par jaunu biznesa projektu.

p.d: Катя и Саша дружили с детства. Но их дружбу разрушила любовь к одному мужчине – Артему, который выбрал Катю. День свадьбы должен был стать самым счастливым в жизни влюбленных, но стал последним их днем. Жестокая игра дяди Артема – Валерия, жаждущего денег и власти, едва не стоила жизни Кате и сделала несчастной Сашу. И только простив друг друга, подруги смогли все преодолеть и найти настоящую любовь. На этот раз – каждая свою...

Мечту скромной медсестры Ксении о прекрасной жизни в новом месте с любимым человеком неожиданно разбивает известие о тяжелой болезни ее мамы. Ксения вынуждена отменить свой переезд за границу и искать деньги на дорогостоящую операцию. Оставшись одна, без жилья и без работы, она пытается сделать все, что в ее силах. Неожиданно она получает предложение стать сиделкой в доме обеспеченной вдовы Ольги Болговой. Ксения с радостью принимает это предложение. Новый дом и его обитатели поначалу пугают ее, но постепенно Ксения привыкает. Она пытается наладить жизнь в доме и помочь выздороветь Ольге. К ее радости, ей начинает это удаваться. Но на самом деле Ксения еще не понимает, в какую опасную игру ее втянули…

Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

p.t: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
p.d: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

p.t: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
p.d: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.
A family's Passover gets screwy after the patriarch unknowingly ingests a hit of Ecstasy.

This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

Unlucky in love, living at home with her eccentric mom, and stuck in a dead end secretarial job at Judge Pharmaceuticals, Sarah Jane longs for more out of life. Her surprise promotion to junior executive appears to be just the ticket. But with promotion comes a competitive new world of wily, complicated executives, and Sarah Jane begins to eliminate the competition the only way she knows how - murder. During her climb to the top, she unexpectedly falls for the man of her dreams, Detective Bill Malloy - the cop intent on cracking the case of the mysterious deaths at Judge Pharmaceuticals.

One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?
A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

1951. gada beigās Eilisa Leisija (Sīrša Ronana) pamet Īriju un dodas uz Bruklinu, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atbalstot savu ģimeni. Viņai palīdz tēvs Flads, un Eilisa drīz nonāk dzīves ritenī, strādājot universālveikalā un studējot grāmatvedību. Kad viņa saskatās ar itāļu izcelsmes amerikāņu santehniķi, viņa saprot, ka ir pilnībā iemīlējusies. Taču pēc traģiska negadījuma viņai jādodas atpakaļ mājās, kur atjauno saites ar bijušajiem draugiem un mēģina izprast, kur veidot savu dzīvi tālāk.

Rozannai jeb Rozai pēc 50 gadiem ir jāpamet psihiatriskā klīnika, ko sieviete sauc par mājām visus šos gadus. Roza atsakās vietu pamest. Kad pie viņas ierodas ārsts Viljams Grīns, viņš uzzina, ka Roza piekopj savādus ikdienas rituālus un ilgus gadus rakstījusi dienasgrāmatu ar kodētiem ierakstiem. Jaunā Roza Otrā pasaules kara laikā ir zaudējusi savu māti un negaidīti iemīlas lidotājā. Tomēr Rozu pašu nolūkojis vietējais priesteris. Savstarpējās attiecības kļūst sarežģītas. Pēc daudziem gadiem slēptā patiesība pamazām atklājas Rozas dienasgrāmatu ierakstos. Galvenās lomas atveidotāja ir Rūnija Mara, amerikāņu aktrise, divu "Oskara" balvu nominante, arī viņas māsa Keita Mara ir aktrise un popularitāti guva ar Zojas lomu politiskajā detektīvseriālā "Kāršu namiņš" kopā ar Kevinu Speisiju un Robinu Raitu. Rūnija Mara atveidojusi lomas tādās filmās kā "Meitene ar pūķa tetovējumu", "Blakusefekts", "Kerola". Īru režisors Džims Šeridans ir veidojis tādas filmas kā "Mana kreisā kāja", "Brāļi", "Bokseris". Karjeras laikā nominēts sešiem "Oskariem" kā labākais režisors un scenārija autors. Lomās: Rūnija Mara, Vanesa Redgreiva, Teo Džeimss, Eidans Tērners, un citi. Rež: Džims Šeridans

Ševals ir pastnieks, kurš katru dienu ceļo pa Dromas upes apkārtni. Viņš satiek savas dzīves īsto sievieti Filomenu, un no viņu savienības piedzimst Alise. Tad viņš metas trakā azartspēlē: savām rokām uzcelt viņai neticamu pili.

Stāsts par parastu cilvēku - britu mākleri Nikolasu Vintonu, kurš Otrā pasaules kara priekšvakarā palīdzēja izglābt simtiem Čehoslovākijas bērnu no nacistu iebrukuma. Piecdesmit gadus vēlāk, 1988. gadā, Nikiju joprojām vajā to bērnu liktenis, kurus viņš nebija spējis evakuēt uz Angliju. Līdz kādā BBC televīzijas raidījuma tiešraidē viņš tiek iepazīstināts ar dažiem no izdzīvojušajiem, tagad jau pieaugušajiem bērniem, un viņš beidzot sāk mācīties sev piedot.
Pēc atbrīvošanas no cietuma jauns vīrietis negribīgi dodas ceļojumā kopā ar savu atsvešināto tēvu, lai izkaisītu mātes pelnus viņas dzimtajā Īrijā.

Kad sešpadsmitgadīgais Džons Pols Getijs III tiek nolaupīts, viņa izmisusī māte Geila lūdz jaunekļa vectēvu, naftas magnātu, samaksāt izpirkumu. Kad miljardieris Getijs atsakās, Geila visiem spēkiem mēģina viņu pārliecināt, jo dēla nolaupītāji kļūst arvien brutālāki. Kamēr zēna dzīvība karājas mata galā, negaidīti par Geilas sabiedroto šajā cīņā kļūst Getija konsultants Flečers Čeiss, bijušais CIP darbinieks.

Dziedātājs. Nemiernieks. Izraidītais. Varonis. Džonijs Kešs. Ar tik smagiem akordiem, kas spētu aizkustināt pat kravas vilcienu, tēraudpelēko acu intensīvo skatienu un balsi, tumšu kā nakts, leģendārais "Vīrs melnā" sarīkoja mūzikā revolūciju un pats radīja savu īstas amerikāņu leģendas imidžu. Būdams cilvēks, kura dzīvi vada spēcīgas kaislības, Džonijs Kešs nekad neatteicās no savas kontraversālās personības. Savas karjeras sākumā viņš satika vienīgo patieso savu mūža mīlestību Džūnu Kārteri, kas spēja viņu glābt no sevis paša.

Divas jaunas misionāru meitenes klauvē pie kādas mājas durvīm. Tās atver omulīgais misters Rīds, kurš viņas aicina iekšā. Ātri vien meitenes apjēdz, ka nokļuvušas velnišķīgā slazdā un šī ir spēle uz dzīvību un nāvi.

Kērtiss Laforšs kopā ar sievu Samantu un nedzirdīgo meitiņu Hannu dzīvo nelielā Ohaio pilsētā. Naudas ir maz, turklāt Hannai ir nepieciešama īpaša medicīniskā aprūpe un izglītība. Tomēr par spīti visam Kērtiss un Samanta mīl viens otru, un visi kopā viņi ir laimīga ģimene. Kad Kērtiss redz šausminošus sapņus par katastrofālus plūdus nesošu vētru, viņš nolemj mazināt satraukumu, ceļot patvertni ģimenes mājas pagalmā. Rezultātā sarežģās viņa attiecības ar sievu.
Maiju valstībai piedzīvojot tās norietu, jauns vīrietis dodas bīstamā ceļojumā uz pasauli, kurā valda bailes un apspiešana.

Jūens Makgregors un Naomi Votsa aizkustinošā filmā, kas uzņemta, balstoties uz patiesiem notikumiem par ģimeni, kas atradās 2004. gada postošā cunami pašā tā epicentrā Taizemē. Šis cunami atzīts par vispostošāko dabas katastrofu modernajā vēsturē. Marija, Henrijs un viņu trīs dēli dodas svinēt Ziemassvētkus Taizemē. 26. decembra rītā pār piekrasti veļas ūdens siena, kas savā ceļā aizskalo visu. Neticamā veidā ģimene izdzīvo, taču cunami viņus nošķir vienu no otra. Starp postījumiem, sāpēm un izmisumu viņiem ir jāpaveic neiespējamais - jāatrod vienam otru...

Ollijs Kross ir jauns feldšeris, kurš strādā Ņujorkas nakts maiņā kopā ar pieredzējušu un nelokāmu partneri Džīnu Rutkovski. Katrs 911 izsaukums bieži ir bīstams un neparedzams, ik dienu liekot viņu dzīvības uz spēles, lai palīdzētu citiem.

Every region has its own local culture and flavor. One of the best ways for a traveler to immerse him or herself in new destinations is to taste these unique dishes. This taste exploration allows even the strictest of dieters the freedom to indulge. In the new series, Travel Channel's Man v. Food, host Adam Richman sets out to travel the country in search of the best places to do some serious indulging. Starting season 5, Casey Webb took over as host.

Ree Drummond is cooking mega with big food for the big game. She kicks things off with her Bodacious Burger, a stacked sandwich with tiers of Quick and Easy Mac and 3 Cheeses, Onion Strings and terrific toppings. Then she makes over-the-top Monster Meatballs, a Super-Sized Slice of Pizza using her Foolproof Pizza Dough for her football-mad son and a mammoth Mile High Mud Pie that's perfect game-watching grub.

Ree Drummond is making divine chocolate treats for her daughter, Paige, to share with her school friends, and she's sneaking in a few for her husband, Ladd, while she's at it. There are adorable Classic Chocolate Cups decorated with homemade Sugared Orange Peels and a bunch of store-bought toppings. Ree shows her love with over-the-top Love and Kisses Cookies and the easiest Chipotle Fudge, and double-dipped Cookies and Cream Marshmallow Treats are made with oodles of chocolate and lots of fun.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Elizabeth prepares a special barbecue dinner for her family visiting the ranch. She makes fresh baked herb focaccia with edible flowers and BBQ pork ribs.

Esther Choi makes some favourite Korean classics - Korean barbecue of LA Kalbi with Ssamjangand and a hot pot: bulgogi mushroom jeongol.
Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi and shares kimchi recipes, including kimchi fried rice and Korean pork belly wraps.
Maneet Chauhan prepares a crowd-pleasing appetizer of crispy fried Samosas with a creamy potato pea filling and a spicy main course of pork vindaloo.
Chef Maneet Chauhan makes chicken biryani with layers of marinated chicken, herbs, rice, saffron milk, cashews, golden raisins and much more.
The returning winner defends their title against Franklin Becker and Allison Fasano as they ignite the judges' taste buds with their spiciest dishes.

Robert Irvine goes to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California for a mission in paradise. After 2020 put a damper on the small island's tourism season, Robert is called to ring in the new season and celebrate the island getting back on its feet. He needs to make a celebratory meal for 75 locals, but every dish must be handheld and include either bison or seafood -- two of the island's most revered ingredients. After building his own kitchen and braving the open ocean in a kayak, Robert gets pulled in one more direction: He must help a local restaurant open with a bang, Restaurant: Impossible-style. With everything on his plate, Robert struggles to finish this dinner in time and not let down the locals.

Robert Irvine is ready for any challenge he is challenged to overcome culinary obstacles and deliver a delicious meal before his time runs out. With new challenges from this exciting, fun-loving chef, viewers will see if Robert can make dinner, possible!

Robert Irvine travels to Asheville, N.C., to compete in the annual Asheville Food Truck Showdown. He and his team face off against three of the best food trucks in the state. With a $1,500 budget, the mission is to prepare enough food for 500 people and use beer in every dish, and the truck that makes the most money wins. Anything can happen as food truck novice Robert competes against seasoned teams who cook in food trucks every day.

Filmu "Ledus laikmets" un "Ledus Laikmets 2" varoņi ir atgriezušies - gatavi jauniem piedzīvojumiem. Skrets joprojām nododas nenotveramās zīles medībām. Menijs un Elija gaida mazuļa piedzimšanu, sliņķis Sids mēģina iztēloties ģimenes dzīvi, rūpējoties par nočieptām dinozaura olām, bet zobenzobu tīģeris Djego apsver, vai viņš nav kļuvis pārāk mīkstčaulīgs, tik daudz laika pavadot draugu kompānijā. Dodoties glābt nelaimē nokļuvušo Sidu, draugi nokļūst neparastā pazemes pasaulē, kur aci pret aci sastopas ar dinozauriem un ir spiesti cīnīties gan ar zvēriem, gan augiem.

Zvirbulis Ričijs kopš dzimšanas pieņemts stārķu ģimenē, visi viņu ļoti mīl, viņš ātri aug un jūtas kā īsts stārķis. Taču gājputniem stārķiem pienāk laiks lidot uz Āfriku, lai tur ziemotu. Ģimene ir spiesta atklāt Ričijam viņa izcelšanos, jo lidot kopā nedrīkst – grūtajā ceļojumā zvirbulis var iet bojā. Drosminieks negrasās nolaist spārnus un nolemj visiem pierādīt, ka ir īsts stārķis. Ričijs viens pats dodas ceļā, un viņam pievienojas jauni draugi – pūce Olga un papagailis Kiki.

Makss (Luiss Sīkejs) ir enerģisks un sajūsmināts Džeka Rasela terjers, kurš dzīvo Manhetenas dzīvoklī kopā ar īpašnieci Keitiju (Elija Kempere). Taču viņa laimīgā dzīve pārtrūkst, kad saimniece pieņem jaunu suni Grāfu (Ēriks Stounstrīts). Makss apņemas atgūt saimnieces uzmanību tikai sev un mēģina Grāfu atstāt kādā sānielā, taču viņus ielenc kaķu banda, kuru vada Ozons (Stīvs Kūgans). Viņi tik tikko izglābj savas dzīvības, kad nākas saskarties ar pamesto dzīvnieku armijas niknumu apburošā, bet psihiski nelīdzsvarotā truša Sniegapikas (Kevins Hārts) vadībā. Šis ir Ņujorkas piedzīvojums, kurš liek Maksam un Grāfam izvērtēt savu sacensību un mēģināt izjaukt Sniegapikas atriebes plānu pret visiem dzīvnieku īpašniekiem Ņujorkā.

Kosmiskais kuģis ar pieciem tūkstošiem pasažieru, kuri ir iegremdēti mākslīgajā sapnī, ceļo uz planētu, kas viņiem kļūs par jauno mājvietu. Negaidītas sistēmas kļūmes dēļ divi pasažieri Džims un Aurora pamostas ātrāk un saprot, ka līdz ceļojuma galapunktam vēl ir jālido 90 gadi, kas nozīmē, ka dzīves atlikušo daļu viņiem nāksies pavadīt divatā kosmiskā kuģa greznajā interjerā. Laiks skrien, un pakāpeniski viņi sajūt abpusējas simpātijas... Taču pēkšņi atklājas, ka kuģim draud briesmas...

Monstru ģimene šoreiz dodas brīvdienās. Luksusa kruīza kuģis aizvedīs Drakulu prom no rūpēm par viesnīcas apmeklētāju labsajūtu. Un kas ir atpūta bez draugiem, kuri tāpat ar prieku metas baudīt kuģa sniegtās izklaides! Taču, kad Drakula iemīlas noslēpumainajā kapteinē Ērikā, viņš vēl nenojauš, ka Ērika ir monstru lielākā ienaidnieka Ābrahama van Helsinga pēctece un sākas mošķu cienīga drāma.

Pasaulslaveno pirmdienu nīdēju un lazanjas mīlētāju mājas kaķi Garfīldu gaida vājprātīgi jautrs piedzīvojums brīvā dabā! Negaidīti saticis savu sen zudušo tēvu, noplukušo ielas kaķi Viku, Gārfīlds kopā ar savu draugu, suni Odiju, ir spiests pamest ideālo lutekļa dzīvi un piebiedroties Vikam pārgalvīgā laupīšanā.

Sava nežēlīgā vīra ietekmē Bella (Emma Stouna) ir izdarījusi pašnāvību, taču ekscentrisks zinātnieks (Vilems Defo) nolemj izglābt sievieti un pārstāda viņai pašas vēl nedzimušā bērna smadzenes. Viņa aizbildniecībā Bella alkst mācīties un iepazīt dzīvi, kas Viktorijas laikmeta stingrajā sabiedrībā viņai līdz šim bijusi liegta. Kopā ar viltīgo un valdzinoši cinisko juristu Dankanu Vederbērnu viņa dodas ceļojumā pāri kontinentiem. Ceļojuma laikā Bella arvien vairāk atbrīvojas no sava laikmeta aizspriedumiem un sabiedrības ierobežojumiem.
Izdzīvojusi Grenlandes bunkurā, Garitiju ģimene dodas pāri sagrautai Eiropai, lai atrastu jaunas mājas.

Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".
Untumains pensionēts rakstnieks negribīgi sāk piedalīties savas pēdējās grāmatas veicināšanas kampaņā, lai izpalīdzētu jaunai izdevējai.

Pandumānija turpinās! Kļuvis par varoni, panda Po nu kopā ar saviem draugiem Tīģerieni, Dzērvi, Čūsku, Pērtiķi un Dievlūdzēju aizsargā dzimto ieleju un tās iemītniekus. Taču Po mierīgajai dzīvei tiek pielikts punkts brīdī, kad uzrodas ļaundaris, kurš, liekot lietā noslēpumainu spēku, grib pakļaut Ķīnu. Pandai kopā ar draugiem būs jādodas cauri visai Ķīnai, lai uzveiktu pretinieku.

Kādā tālā zemē ļaunais valdnieks izraida uz mežu visus pasaku varoņus, lai zeme būtu tikpat garlaicīga kā pats valdnieks. Lielā milža Šreka mājvieta pārtop par bēgļu nometni. Tāpēc viņš nolemj atrast bargo valdnieku un pārliecināt, lai viņš atļauj zemes iemītniekiem atgriezties mājās. Valdnieks piekrīt, bet ar vienu nosacījumu – Šrekam jāatrod un jāatved daiļā princese Fiona, kuru ļaunais valdnieks nolēmis apprecēt, lai kļūtu par karali. Filma dublēta latviešu valodā.

Princeses Fionas vecāki ielūdz savu meitu un viņas jauno vīru uz svinīgām pusdienām savā pilī. Taču karaļpāris ij nenojauš, kā izskatās jaunais znots un cik ļoti viņu mazā meitiņa ir pārvērtusies... Gan Fiona, gan viņas iemīļotais Šreks ir zaļi, milzīgi cilvēkēdāji! Vai jaunlaulātajiem ir kaut mazākās cerības iegūt pavalstnieku labvēlību?

Tas ir stāsts par Oza zemes raganām. Elfaba ir apkārtējo nesaprasta savas zaļās ādas krāsas dēļ un ir ceļā, lai atklātu savu patieso spēku. Glinda ir populāra un priviliģēta jauniete, kura vēl nav atklājusi savu patieso sirdi. Pēc tikšanās ar Oza zemes burvi viņu draudzība nonāk krustcelēs.

Skreta (Kriss Vedžs) nepārtrauktie pūliņi noglabāt savu zīli liek viņam izraisīt negadījumu virkni, kuru rezultātā asteroīdi sāk traukties uz Zemi. Haoss liek Manijam (Rejs Romano), Djego (Deniss Līrijs), Sidam (Džons Legvizamo) un viņu ģimenēm meklēt patvērumu. Piedzīvojumu meklētāja zebiekste Baks (Saimons Pegs) viņus brīdina, ka var sākties masveida izmiršana, kas liek draugiem meklēt jaunu mājvietu, pa ceļam satiekot citus dzīvniekus un apmeklējot eksotiskas vietas.

Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

p.d: Matt Blashaw is determined to find the Gordon family the perfect vacation home in Lake Tahoe. They are hoping to buy a rustic, three bedroom-two bath home with convenient access to both the Lake and the mountains. With a central location being high on their list, Matt works to find an affordable fixer-upper that will get top dollar in the rental market after an extensive face lift. The Gordon's decide that putting time and money into a home in a prime location will ultimately allow them to live their dream in this year-round paradise.

Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

A couple looks to relocate from wet and chilly Seattle to the sunshine and warm weather of the Dominican Republic.
The Kalamas switch to renovating a condo for resale when a shutdown halts their other project.

Daphne and Ian's lives change forever when she unexpectedly inherits a 500-year-old castle in France from her grandfather. Desperate to continue her grandfather's legacy, the young couple must save the decaying relic from ruin or face losing it forever.

Cheap Old Houses is inspired by Ethan and Elizabeth Finkelstein's uber popular Instagram feed by the same name, which racks up millions of views with images of surprising property bargains that are architecturally intact and available for under $150,000. In each episode, cameras will follow the couple as they tour low-priced older houses across America and ultimately choose which ones to feature on their famous site.
